name: Everdell
metaDescription: Free Everdell score calculator for 1–4 players. Add card points, prosperity bonuses, point tokens, journey and events, plus Pearlbrook pearls and wonders.
intro: Everdell's final count spans your whole city: base points on every card, the bonuses from purple prosperity cards, tokens, the journey and events. Enter each player's totals and the calculator adds them up.

categories.label: Base card points
categories.help: Points printed on every critter and construction in your city.

categories.label: Prosperity card bonuses
categories.help: Extra points from purple prosperity cards, such as the Castle or Palace, scored for what is in your city.

categories.label: Point tokens
categories.help: The value of the point tokens you collected during the game.

categories.label: Journey
categories.help: Points from the journey spaces your workers went to in autumn.

categories.label: Events
categories.help: Points from basic and special events you achieved.

expansions.name: Pearlbrook
expansions.description: Adds pearls, wonders and adornments. Each pearl is worth 2 points.

categories.label: Pearls
categories.help: Pearls left at the end of the game.

categories.label: Adornments
categories.help: Points from adornment cards you played.

tiebreaker: If players are tied, the one who achieved the most events wins. If still tied, the player with the most leftover resources wins.

rules.heading: How scoring works in Everdell
body: Everdell ends when every player has passed after their last season. Each player then adds up the points from five sources: the base points on their cards, bonuses from prosperity cards, point tokens, the journey and events.

rules.heading: Cards and prosperity bonuses
body: Every card shows its base points in the top-left corner. Purple prosperity cards also score a bonus based on the rest of your city, for example points for every common construction. Add the base value of all cards first, then the prosperity bonuses as a separate total, so nothing gets counted twice or missed.

rules.heading: Tokens, journey and events
body: Point tokens are collected from card effects and locations during the game. The journey is available only in autumn: the points shown on the journey spaces you occupied are yours. Basic events are worth 3 points each, and special events show their own value, sometimes with extra points for resources placed on them.

rules.heading: Pearlbrook
body: Pearlbrook adds the river. Each pearl you still hold at the end is worth 2 points, and wonders and adornments score the values shown on them. Turn on the expansion above to add these rows.

faq.q: How much is a basic event worth in Everdell?
faq.a: 3 points. Special events show their own point value.
No, but they break ties after the number of events.

faq.q: How much is a pearl worth in Pearlbrook?
faq.a: 2 points each at the end of the game.
